title: Accounts Assistant
description:
Stockport £30,000 per annum + study + benefits

Join a successful manufacturing business where your contribution really counts.

Are you an organised, detail-oriented finance professional looking for your next opportunity within a supportive team? This is a great opportunity to join an established packaging business in Stockport, as an Accounts Assistant, supporting the day-to-day running of the finance function.

Reporting directly to the Finance Manager, you ll play an important role in keeping financial records accurate, ensuring transactions are processed efficiently and helping the business maintain effective financial controls.

This is a varied, hands-on position offering the opportunity to build on your existing accounts experience, develop your skills and gain broader exposure to the finance function.

The role

Working closely with the Finance Manager and wider business, your responsibilities will include:
- Processing purchase invoices and credit notes, ensuring accurate coding, supporting documentation and approvals.
- Maintaining customer and supplier accounts and allocating receipts and payments.
- Completing bank reconciliations and investigating discrepancies or unreconciled transactions.
- Supporting credit control by monitoring outstanding balances, issuing statements and following up overdue invoices.
- Checking employee expenses and maintaining petty cash records.
- Assisting with month-end activities, including ledger checks, accruals, prepayments and supporting schedules.
- Providing financial information for VAT returns, audits and management reporting.
- Responding to customer and supplier queries professionally and helping resolve issues promptly.
- Maintaining accurate, organised and confidential financial records.
- Identifying opportunities to improve routine processes and supporting the wider finance team as required.

About you

You ll be numerate, methodical and comfortable working with financial information, with a strong eye for detail and a proactive approach to getting things done.

We re looking for someone with:
- A good understanding of basic bookkeeping and purchase and sales ledger processes.
- Strong numerical skills and a high level of accuracy.
- Confidence using Microsoft Excel, including basic formulas, sorting and filtering.
- Good organisational skills, with the ability to prioritise tasks and meet deadlines.
- Clear communication skills and a professional approach to customer and supplier queries.
- The ability to work independently on routine tasks while contributing positively to a team.
- A responsible approach to confidentiality and sensitive financial information.

Previous experience in an accounts, bookkeeping or finance administration role would be advantageous. AAT qualified, studying towards AAT, or equivalent practical experience would also be welcomed.

Experience with bank reconciliations, credit control, month-end processes or accounting software would be beneficial, although a willingness to learn is just as important.

What s on offer?
- £30,000 annual salary plus benefits
- The opportunity to join an established business.
- A varied role with exposure to several areas of finance.
- Direct support and development from the Finance Manager.
- The opportunity to strengthen your accounting skills and develop your experience within a busy finance function.

Interested?

If you re looking for a hands-on Accounts Assistant role where you can make a valuable contribution, build your experience and become part of a supportive finance team, we d love to hear from you.

Apply today to find out more.

title: Accounts Assistant
company: JANE GORSE RECRUITMENT LIMITED - Agency - Permanent
description:
Accounts Assistant

Hale £26,000-£28,000

Supporting the Legal Cashiering Team

Good with numbers? Love getting the detail right? Ready for your next move in accounts?

Jane Gorse Recruitment is recruiting an Accounts Assistant to join an established law firm in Hale. You'll support the Legal Cashiering Team, helping to keep transactions accurate, payments running smoothly and financial records in excellent shape.

If you enjoy balancing the books, solving queries and being the person your colleagues can rely on, this could be a great next step.

The role

Working closely with the legal cashiers and wider business, you'll get involved in:
- Posting transactions accurately to client and office ledgers.
- Processing payments, cheque requests and account transfers.
- Completing daily bank reconciliations.
- Helping prepare weekly payment runs.
- Maintaining financial records and investigating ledger queries.
- Supporting month-end processes and VAT returns.
- Assisting with petty cash and residual client balances.
- Following the procedures that keep client money protected and accounts compliant.
- Providing cover for colleagues and suggesting ways to improve everyday processes.

What you'll bring

We're keen to hear from candidates with accounts experience, strong attention to detail and a proactive approach.

You'll be someone who:
- Enjoys working with numbers and checking that everything adds up.
- Has experience with financial transactions, reconciliations or maintaining accounts records.
- Communicates clearly and confidently with colleagues.
- Can organise a varied workload and meet deadlines.
- Handles sensitive financial information with care and discretion.
- Is comfortable using accounts software and learning new systems.
- Takes pride in being helpful, reliable and accurate.

Experience within a legal accounts team would be useful. If your background is in a different sector, please highlight your relevant accounts experience and interest in moving into legal finance.

The benefits

There's plenty on offer beyond the £25,000-£28,000 salary:
- Employee bonus scheme offering up to an additional 10% of annual salary, subject to terms and conditions.
- Your birthday off.
- Healthcare package including 24/7 GP access and contributions towards dental, optical and physiotherapy costs.
- Gym membership.
- Death-in-service cover of four times your salary.
- Company pension.
- Counselling support and monthly office massages.
- A range of lifestyle benefits, including Netflix, Spotify and Amazon Prime.

Benefits are subject to the employer's scheme terms and eligibility.

Ready to make your next move?

Apply with your CV to Jane Gorse Recruitment. We'd love to hear about your accounts experience and what you're looking for next.

title: Finance Assistant / Stock Controller
description:
Finance Assistant / Stock Controller

A varied finance opportunity combining reporting, stock control and improvement work in a hands-on manufacturing setting. It suits someone with relevant finance, accounts, stock control or manufacturing experience and strong Excel skills.

If you've also worked in the following roles, we'd also like to hear from you: Accounts Assistant, Finance Officer, Accounts Administrator, Finance Administrator, Assistant Accountant, Inventory Controller, Stock Control Assistant, Accounts Clerk

This job is officially known within the business as Assistant to Financial Controller

SALARY: £25,000 - £27,500 per annum + Benefits

LOCATION: Hyde, Greater Manchester, North West England

JOB TYPE: Full-Time, Permanent

WORKING HOURS: 35 Hours per Week

JOB OVERVIEW

This is a varied opportunity to combine finance support, stock accuracy and business improvement in a practical manufacturing environment. The Finance Assistant / Stock Controller will support reporting, reconciliations, audits and inventory activity.

Working with production, purchasing and warehouse teams brings broad exposure across finance and operations. The Finance Assistant / Stock Controller will help improve stock accuracy, support ERP Bills of Materials and investigate discrepancies.

Alongside operational finance, the Finance Assistant / Stock Controller will support the Financial Controller, coordinate key information and contribute to ad hoc projects and continuous improvement.

DUTIES

Your duties as the Finance Assistant / Stock Controller include:
- Diary and Deadline Coordination: Manage the Financial Controller's diary, calendar, meetings and key deadlines
- Finance Query Support: Act as a first point of contact for finance queries, taking calls and directing requests as required
- Reporting and Documentation: Prepare reports, analysis, presentations and meeting documentation
- Stock Accuracy Relationships: Build strong relationships with production, purchasing and warehouse teams to improve stock accuracy
- Financial Reporting Support: Assist with month-end and year-end reporting, balance sheet reconciliations and inventory-related reporting
- Audit Support: Prepare schedules and provide information to auditors for year-end audit activity
- ERP and BOM Support: Support implementation and maintenance of Bills of Materials (BOMs) within the ERP system
- Stock Management and Checks: Assist with stock management, counts, valuations, discrepancy investigations and ad hoc spot checks in the factory and warehouse
- Intercompany Liaison: Liaise with intercompany stakeholders regarding stock, reporting and reconciliations
- Continuous Improvement and Projects: Contribute to finance and operational improvement initiatives, ad hoc projects and wider business requirements

CANDIDATE REQUIREMENTS

ESSENTIAL
- Previous experience in finance, accounts, stock control or a manufacturing environment
- Strong Excel and analytical skills
- Excellent organisation and time management abilities
- Confident communication skills and the ability to work across multiple departments
- HNC/HND qualification (or equivalent financial qualification)
- Proactive, highly organised, meticulous and detail-oriented approach
- Comfortable working in the office and on the factory floor
- Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
- Team-oriented approach with the ability to build relationships across the business
- Ability to work methodically, independently and efficiently within deadlines
- Willingness to take ownership and drive continuous improvement initiatives

DESIRABLE
- Manufacturing environment and ERP systems experience

BENEFITS
- 28 days' holiday including statutory days, rising by one day after one completed year of service
- Life assurance covering annual salary
- Subsidised canteen offering freshly cooked meals and sandwiches every day
- Free car parking
- Employee Assistance Programme with counselling support, legal guidance and medical advice from qualified nurses for the employee and immediate family
- Mental Health First Aiders providing support and guidance
- Discounted gym membership
- Discounted blinds and shutters following successful completion of the probationary period
- Peer-to-peer recognition programme
- Free flu jab voucher every autumn
- Christmas Savings Scheme
- NHS Health Checks

By submitting your job application to us you are hereby giving us your express consent to submit your details to our Client for this purpose.

title: Payroll and Finance Administrator (12 Month FTC)
description:
Our client is a leading provider of specialist care services across the UK, supporting individuals with complex needs and learning disabilities. Their services include supported living, residential emergency accommodation, and specialist step-down services for individuals with mental health needs. They have a mission is to deliver meaningful and lasting positive change in the lives of both adults and children and empower the people they support to live as independently as possible, promoting dignity, choice, autonomy and self-worth in everything they do.

Due to a period of pending MAT leave, they are looking for a Payroll and Finance Administrator to be based out of their Altrincham headquarters four days per week, with a day working from home on a 12 month FTC. As Payroll and Finance Administrator, you'll be a proactive and organised, ensuring accurate, timely payroll and supporting wider finance operations. This role offers the chance to work across all group companies and make a real impact. You'll be joining at an exciting point in our client's growth journey, with plenty of opportunities to develop your skills,

Payroll and Finance Administrator - Responsibilities
- Deliver accurate, end-to-end monthly payroll processing for over 300 employees, including RTI submissions
- Support with system and process improvement to enable the payroll function to scale with the business as employee numbers grow
- Assist with PAYE/NIC reconciliations
- Work closely with Operations to ensure accuracy with timesheets, overtime, and enhancements
- Collaborating with HR to ensure all starters, leavers, and contractual changes information is accurate and timely
- Mange pension auto-enrolment and uploads
- Maintain accurate payroll records and audit trails
- Support with payroll reconciliations to the general ledger
- Assist with year-end processes (P60s, P11 Ds where applicable)
- Support purchase ledger processing and procurement when required#

Payroll and Finance Administrator - Required Skills
- Payroll experience working in a staff heavy business, with hourly paid and shift based work is essential
- Strong knowledge of UK payroll legislation, tax, NI, statutory payments, and pensions
- Confident using payroll systems and Excel
- Highly organised, methodical and process driven with the ability to manage deadlines
- Ability to balance strong numerical accuracy and attention to detail with sound communication skills
- General finance experience and an understanding of bookkeeping is advantageous

As Payroll and Finance Administrator, you will play a vital role in maintaining smooth financial payroll operations. You should be an organised, proactive, and detail-oriented individual. The right individual will have the opportunity to add genuine value and to keep developing their skills within a fast-growing company.

Apply now to be considered for their Payroll and Finance Administrator FTC positon.

title: Part-Time Bookkeeper
description:
Are you an experienced Bookkeeper looking for a flexible, part-time opportunity within a friendly and professional accountancy practice?

Our client is looking for an organised and experienced Part-Time Bookkeeper to join their team in Urmston, Manchester.

Working with a varied portfolio of sole traders and small to medium-sized businesses, you'll take responsibility for day-to-day bookkeeping, VAT returns and personal Self Assessment tax returns.

This is a hands-on role suited to someone with previous accountancy practice experience who can work independently, manage deadlines and hit the ground running.

What Will You Be Doing?
- Maintaining accurate bookkeeping records for sole traders and limited companies.
- Reconciling bank accounts, credit cards and sales and purchase ledgers.
- Preparing VAT returns and supporting reconciliations.
- Preparing straightforward personal Self Assessment tax returns.
- Investigating and resolving bookkeeping discrepancies.
- Liaising directly with clients and following up on outstanding information.
- Managing your workload and ensuring deadlines are met.
- Preparing clear and accurate records for review.

What Are We Looking For?
- Previous experience working within an accountancy or bookkeeping practice (essential).
- Practical experience preparing VAT and personal Self Assessment returns.
- Strong double-entry bookkeeping and reconciliation skills.
- Good understanding of VAT, allowable business expenses and personal income sources.
- Confident using accounting and tax software.
- Ability to work independently, manage deadlines and communicate effectively.
- AAT/ICB qualification or qualified by experience.

Experience with CIS, payroll and rental income would be an advantage.

Software Experience

Our client uses a range of accounting and tax packages, including:

Sage, Xero, FreeAgent, Digita, Apron, Dext, TaxCalc, Pixie and Engager.

What's on Offer?
- £12,000 £15,000 actual annual salary for 16 hours per week.
- 16 hours per week, with flexibility to spread the hours across different days.
- Paid holiday and workplace pension in line with statutory requirements.
- Free on-street parking available nearby.
- Opportunity to work with a varied portfolio of clients.
- A friendly, supportive team with a relaxed working culture.

About the Team

You'll be joining a friendly accountancy practice where people enjoy working together, having a laugh and supporting one another. The team takes a relaxed approach to the working environment while remaining professional and committed to delivering excellent service to clients.

The role offers the opportunity to work with a varied mix of small and medium-sized businesses, making every day interesting and different.

This is a fully office-based position in Urmston, Manchester, offering 16 hours per week. The working hours can be split across different days during the week, with the exact pattern to be agreed.

How to Apply
